description:
2 Hour Sitar to Clear Your Mind Instantly | Indian Classical Music for Brain Detox

If your brain feels stuck under layers of mental noise — start here. 2 hours of sitar designed to clear the mental fog and reset your focus.

Slow sitar music with a gentle brainwave layer that supports focused attention. Designed for end-of-day mental detox or mid-day brain reset.

🎵 What you'll hear:
- Sitar — the iconic Indian string instrument with bright, clear notes and subtle slides
- Long melodic phrases with space between notes — meditative but never drowsy
- A gentle 40Hz layer associated with focused thinking (use headphones for the effect)
- Unbroken 2 hours of music — no abrupt fades, no startling moments

⏱ Chapters
0:00   Settling — first focused breath
15:00  Mental noise quieting
40:00  Clarity zone
90:00  Sustained focus
110:00 Gentle return

🧠 How to use:
Press play. Let the strings pull your mental noise into shape. Headphones recommended for the brainwave effect. Phone in another room.

⏱ Best for:
• Brain fog / mental overload
• Post-work mental detox
• Long study and focus sessions
• ADHD focus support
• End-of-day cognitive reset

📺 Subscribe to Raga Focus for daily uploads:
- Sitar, Sarangi, Veena, Surbahar, Bansuri, Tanpura and other Indian instruments
- Music for anxiety, overthinking, sleep, stress, emotional release

— Raga Focus
